LanguageData.WVC_GeneResurgentTooltip:
The <color=#8a8ae6>Resurgent</color> gene slowly accumulates <color=#8a8ae6>cells</color> (hediff) in the pawn. <color=#8a8ae6>Cells</color> decrease automatically, by <color=#8a8ae6>1 each day</color>, and <color=#8a8ae6>disappear</color> when they reach 0. Losing the gene <color=#8a8ae6>does not remove accumulated cells</color>. <color=#8a8ae6>Cells</color> are used by subgenes, or subgenes can be directly dependent on them.

<color=#8a8ae6>Resurgent</color> can <color=#8a8ae6>override</color> other genes and <color=#8a8ae6>increase accumulation</color> by 1 for each <color=#8a8ae6>overridden</color> gene. Overridden genes are counted even if they are overridden by other genes.

Overriding subgenes increases accumulation <color=#8a8ae6>according</color> to their <color=#8a8ae6>consumption</color>. If a subgene, while active, accumulates cells, its override will increase consumption.
